description: Presidential Secretariat - Declare that services of Public Transport (Railways) as essential Public Services
reasoning: This gazette content is an order by the President declaring certain public services as essential under the Essential Public Services Act, No. 61 of 1979. It involves the exercise of statutory powers to create a regulatory framework for essential services, specifically targeting public transport and railway services. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it establishes legal requirements and compliance measures under existing legislation.
